messages:
Maria O.: Hey team — auditor asked for end-to-end evidence that RBAC changes, KMS key usage, and audit-log retention map back to our SOC 2 control matrix. They want artifacts showing who approved changes, when keys were used, and immutable logs for the last 6 months. Any gaps?

Raj S.: We have IAM change PRs in infra-repo + deploy records in CI. For KMS: CloudKMS admin logs + CloudTrail events. Do they want raw events or packaged extracts?

Priya C.: Auditor requested both: raw export + a short narrative (control mapping). They want proof of approval chain for changes that affected production secrets (example: key rotation, emergency key revocation).

Tom I.: I can produce a signed bundle:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time 2025-09-01 --end-time 2026-03-01 --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=CreateKey
```
Also can export CloudKMS keyRing activity to compressed NDJSON. Question: do we need a tamper-evident hash chain?

Raj S.: We already store logs in GCS with object versioning + bucket lock for retention. We can generate SHA256 manifests for each-day exports. That should satisfy immutability requirements.

Maria O.: Good. Auditor also asked for RBAC change approvals: they want the PR link, approver, and a snapshot of the policy diff. Can we link PRs to deploy events?

Tom I.: Yes — CI pipeline annotates deploys with PR numbers. I'll produce a CSV: date, pr_url, approver, deploy_id, affected_service. Example row: `2026-01-12, https://git/repo/pulls/412, @raj_s, deploy-az-113, inference-gateway`.

Priya C.: Also capture emergency-access incidents. Auditor flagged one emergency KMS key disable last Oct — they want timeline, justification, and post-incident review.

Raj S.: I pulled the incident thread and the emergency-access runbook steps. We need to redact any unrelated user emails but keep roles. I'll attach a sanitized timeline.

audit-bot: Reminder — evidence packages must include: control-mapping doc, raw logs (NDJSON), hash manifest, PR diffs, CI-deploy mapping, and incident postmortem. Zip size limit 2GB for upload.

Maria O.: Action items:
- Tom: export KMS and CloudTrail events (6 months), produce SHA256 per-file manifest — due Thu EOD (2026-03-26).
- Raj: compile RBAC PRs affecting prod envs, produce diffs and approver list — due Fri (2026-03-27).
- Priya: create control-mapping narrative linking artifacts to SOC2/ISO controls, and sanitize incident doc — due Mon (2026-03-30).

Tom I.: Starting exports now. Will paste S3/GCS staging link when done.

Raj S.: I'll run `git log --pretty=format:"%h,%an,%ad,%s" --grep="rbac"` across infra repos and cross-ref with deploy metadata. Will include a sample snippet in the package.

Priya C.: For the control mapping, I'll use our template: control_id, control_text, evidence_list (artifact filenames), owner, notes. Example: CC6.3 — evidence: `rbac_prs_2025-09-2026-02.csv`, `deploy_mapping.csv`.

Maria O.: Auditor asked a follow-up: can we show proof that key access is limited to specific service accounts and that console access to key material is restricted? They expect an access matrix.

Raj S.: We can export IAM bindings for KMS resources and list service account emails. For console access, we have an IAM condition blocking human principals from kms:CryptoKeyVersion* actions except via privileged-admin role (requires JIT). I'll include the policy snippet.

Tom I.: Policy snippet: 
```
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "no_human_console" {
  role = "roles/cloudkms.admin"
  members = ["serviceAccount:svc-inference@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
}
```
I'll also capture bindings audit view.

audit-bot: Upload checklist created: `evidence-checklist-1923456789.txt`. Please mark when each artifact is uploaded.

Maria O.: Cool. Last question — do we need to include KV cache or application-level logs to show that keys are not exfiltrated? Auditor hinted at app-level telemetry.

Priya C.: We should include a short statement and sampling of application logs showing attempts to access KMS from unexpected hosts — we have none. Include sampling policy and query used to extract samples.

Raj S.: Query we used (Stackdriver):
```
logName="projects/redwood/logs/cloudkms.googleapis.com%2Factivity" 
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail!="svc-*" 
| limit 50
```
I'll include results CSV.

Tom I.: Uploading initial bundles to `gs://redwood-compliance-staging/1923456789/` now. Will post link when finished.

Maria O.: Thanks. Once all artifacts are staged, Priya will produce the final zip and we send to auditor. :thumbsup:

Priya C.: Noted. I'll coordinate with Legal for any redaction review before upload to auditor.

Raj S.: tagging follow-ups: @tom_infra for export link, @priya_c for mapping doc, @maria.o for final sign-off.

Tom I.: link: https://console.cloud.google.com/storage/browser/redwood-compliance-staging/1923456789 — files uploading (6/28).

Maria O.: Great, leaving this thread for now. Ping me if blockers.

(End of thread)
